goal.original: Release 2.1.3 without breaking the ~3,000 users who downloaded 2.1.2.
goal.summary: Release held on Fabio's pre-scene test. Fixes are on master (e028447bc + b40c1a388, pushed): agent i2v_ms takes an end frame alone, Cosmo upscales any frame decoded from a clip with the imageUpscale tool before a frame slot, and a local generation of a different model family frees the engine first (the H3 error-1450 crash). Fabio is testing on `npm start` from master and reports in the fresh session. Fabio's rule: fix until Cosmo does the job without going in circles, only then re-cut.

completed: Crash root cause: Windows error 1450 (aimdo xfer_file_read_at) while staging H3's 25 GB TE with Krea 2's ~18 GB still in RAM. ComfyUI 0.42.1 evicts pins on Windows only under 512 MB free or swap >= 5%; aimdo 0.5.6 does not retry. Same error as MPI-1029. Not reproduced on a second engine (nondeterministic, GPU was Fabio's)

comfyController `_freeOtherModelFamily`: before a LOCAL run whose unet/ckpt/clip/vae files share none with the last generation's, POST /comfy/unload {deep:true} (ComfyUI /free unload_models + free_memory, which resets the node cache). commandExecutor passes `freesOtherModels: outputKind !== 'text'`, so imageDescribe/promptEnhance/speechTranscribe never unload or reset the 'last' set. Detection/automask call sites do not pass it

End frame alone: i2v_ms startFrame `satisfiedBy: 'endFrame'` (commandRegistry + typedef); resolveAgentMedia honours it; connector mediaRolesFor reports startFrame required:false + orRole:'endFrame'; endFrame use text says alone it builds up to the picture

npm test 3778 pass 0 fail; npm run lint (eslint + typecheck) clean; pushed
